scenario: Inlined at compile time per LLET.12.5 — not memoised; runtime sees the expanded expression at every use site. Pin: `let x = t.v + 1` read by two `cache` actions compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` reads no lowering, so the expression at both sites is not observed.

schema Trig scope logical:
